Scheerer, Oro Grande & Mojave named #1 Aggregates Operation, President's Award
reasons.sales_angle: Correction from an earlier draft: this is a safety recognition, not an environmental award. It's a real strength to acknowledge, not a pain point — these three sites have an unusually strong safety culture already in place. That's worth respecting in any outreach (don't lead with a staffing-gap pitch here), but it also means whoever is running day-to-day operations across all three is stretched thin keeping that streak alive while Mojave and Scheerer are simultaneously expanding — a scale-without-more-hands story, just a gentler one.
